purpose: Internal baseline only; not for diagnosis or treatment decisions.

protocol.selection: Predeclared comparison on repeated CV of training partition only; holdout is reserved for the logistic baseline and not used to select between candidates.

cross_validation.scheme: 5-fold stratified CV repeated 3 times on training partition only

feature_group_ablation.method: Remove one configured feature group at a time; compare logistic-regression CV on the exact same training folds.
feature_group_ablation.interpretation: Exploratory predictive ablation, not causal importance; groups may be correlated or redundant.

training_only_threshold_tradeoffs.source: single 5-fold stratified out-of-fold predictions on training partition only
training_only_threshold_tradeoffs.warning: Descriptive trade-offs only; thresholds have not been selected for a clinical use.

training_only_calibrated_threshold_trade.source: nested cross-fitted sigmoid probabilities on training partition: 5 outer folds, each with 5-fold calibration on outer-training rows
training_only_calibrated_threshold_trade.warning: Descriptive trade-offs only; no operating threshold is selected for clinical use.

split_sensitivity.method: 25 repeated stratified 80/20 splits using the fixed logistic-regression specification
split_sensitivity.interpretation: Between-split empirical spread, not a confidence interval; splits overlap and are dependent.

calibration_method.fit: CalibratedClassifierCV with 5 stratified folds on training partition only

targets.holdout_uncertainty_method: 2000 stratified percentile bootstrap replicates, resampling separately within each holdout class; conditional on holdout class counts
targets.calibration: Raw and sigmoid-calibrated probabilities are both reported; calibration is experimental and not selected based on holdout results.
